description:
Demonstrated product development experience on Android
 Demonstrated software engineering practices such as design, documentation, prototype, code, and developer level testing
 Demonstrated mastery of Java, C/C++ and Android programming
 Demonstrated ability to make significant contributions to architecture and design documents
 Demonstrated mastery of object-oriented software design
 Must have solid development experience on various Media formats, H.264/AVC, Media Frameworks such as StageFright and solid understanding of OpenMax IL standards
 Demonstrated working knowledge on streaming protocols such as RTP/RTSP/HTTP
 Comfortable programming at the middleware and device driver level and working on Android.
 Experience with or knowledge of IR.92/IR.94 standards and video conferencing protocols Good team player, assertive, self-starter with a can-do-attitude and good communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills.
 Ability to analyze and break down problems Solid understanding of Intel architecture, and capabilities would be an added advantage - particularly around Intel® ATOM(TM).
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
